# ctx-max — deliverable

**Commit on main:** `819b43229` feat(terminal): window context bar shows the fullest agent's context (fast-forward from `4fa6ed9da`).

## What changed
- `server/tmux-session-manager.ts`: the activity sample keeps every seat joined to a window's panes (same pane-id + process-tree check), not only the first. The first seat stays the window's identity (`seatId`, window naming, badges). `TerminalWindow.context` = `fullestContext(seats)`.
- `lib/context-fill.ts`: `WindowContext` (= `SeatContext` + `seatId` of the fullest seat + `seats` = how many report context); `fullestContext` picks the highest fill (used / window), skips seats without context, `null` when none report, ties keep the earlier seat. `contextLabel` appends ", fullest of N agents: <seat>" when N > 1.
- `types.ts`, `components/context-fill-bar.tsx`, `domain.md` updated to match.

## Every place that renders the bar (all read `TerminalWindow.context`, so all follow)
1. Window-strip button bar + its tooltip text (`terminal-pane-header.tsx`).
2. Window-strip button `aria-label` (same file, `contextLabel`).
3. Window overview row bar (`terminal-window-overview.tsx`).
No other renderer found.

## Acceptance evidence
- **Unit test** (`test/unit/web/features/064-terminal/window-overview.test.ts`, "reports the fullest seat across a tiled window…"): one window with three panes/seats at 20%, 72%, 40% reports 72% and names `pij-b`, identity stays `pij-a`, `seats: 3`; a second window with one seat without data plus one with data reports the one with data (`seats: 1`), identity stays the first. Label wording test in `context-fill.test.tsx`.
- **Browser proof** (real screenshot, not unit-only): my prod build on :3107, sidecar reading a stand-in `/v1/cards` (127.0.0.1:7499) describing three real panes of a scratch tmux session. Strip tooltip: "tiled / pij-proof-first / context 72% (720k / 1.0M), fullest of 3 agents: pij-proof-fullest"; overview row `tiled pij-proof-first` with the orange 72% bar. Files: `chainglass-governance/.harness/government/reports/ctx-max-evidence/{strip-tooltip.webp, strip-isolated.webp, overview.png}`. No real multi-seat window was used (attaching would resize/switch Jordan's sessions).
- **just fft** (nice -n 19, worktree, rebased on `4fa6ed9da`, 15:52–16:00, load 14.6 at start → 39 at end): lint clean (1806 files); build 7/7; typecheck all 9 configs clean; vitest 552 files / 7305 tests passed (7 files / 60 tests skipped, existing); `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` 0 high (3 low, 16 moderate).
